about_the_game:
In this demo you will be thrown into battle as one of the two protagonists. You will be able to try your hand on melee and ranged combat against wild wolf riders and their leader Ginji and the mythical big wolf.

Slash, deflect, jump, dash and shoot your way forward and experience a glimpse of the epic backstory that awaits for you in the full version of the game in a later release.

Each of your actions and enemy actions will pair with the minimalistic BGM to form a unique pattern. The trance-like repetition of tones creates a meditative flow state, drawing you into a musical experience that feels both mystic and intense.

According to myth, in the primordial age before heaven and earth were divided, the Sun and Moon were born. At the end of their eternal cycle, they intertwined and gave birth to a child—tasked with maintaining order on the surface world. But each time that child perished, harmony dissolved. To restore balance, the Sun and Moon would summon champions and begin the great "Matsuri"—a sacred ritual where rhythm becomes the path to rebirth.

The demo presents one stage right out of the middle of the story and you will take on the role of one of the champions going straight into battle.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD FX-8350 / Intel® Core™ i5-3330
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon™ R9 280
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound® compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 3 3100 / Intel® Core™ i7-3770
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 6 GB VRAM / Radeon™ RX 480
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound® compatible sound card

short_description: In this demo you can get an early taste on how the game creates a trance like musical experience and introduces you to battle as one of the two protagonists in a mythological world.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
